comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (31.9%) to MtDef4. GRAVY = -1.0338028169; The molecular weight = 8344.447; molecular formula C346H548N124O102S8; molar extinction coefficient = 15882.5. identified from a rumen bacterial metagenome library. Activity: bacteriostatic against E. faecalis (MIC 100-200 ug/ml) (cf. positive control: vancomycin 62.5 ug/ml). Also inhibited growth of E. coli,no MIC. In vitro toxicity: sheep RBC, poor hemo.lytic 12.8% at 400 ug/ml. Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli: IPTG induced expression in LB, purified and quantified by UV, peptide yield: 0.8 mg/L. Updated 5/2025
title: Buwchitin: A Ruminal Peptide with Antimicrobial Potential against Enterococcus faecalis
